khung.tieu_de: Side-by-Side Reflection: Annual Chart Rhythm & Face / Palm Observations
khung.phu_de: Your birth chart maps seasonal structure and annual cycles, while Classical Annual Facial Zones and Two-Hand Palmistry reflect daily habits you are actively cultivating. Each perspective stands independently with no merged score.
khung.ranh_gioi: Facial complexion and palm creases shift with sleep, stress, and work habits; this reflection is never medical advice or a lifespan prediction.
khung.tuoi_nho: Physiognomy and natal cross-reflection is available only for users aged 16 and older.

saint_germain_1897.sach: Comte C. de Saint-Germain · The Practice of Palmistry for Professional Purposes (1897, public domain)

ngon_cai.nguyen_van_en: It would be a loss of space for me to expatiate further on the extraordinary value and interest of the thumb in its physical as well as ethnological aspect.
ngon_cai.y_ung_dung: Thumb carriage and balance reflect how steadily you pace personal discipline during demanding annual transitions.

duong_tri_dao.ten: Line of Head — Focus & Deliberate Judgment
duong_tri_dao.nguyen_van_en: This is the line which acts as a clear and accurate gauge as to the intellectual worth of the subject and as to the healthy condition of his, or her, brain and blood circulation.
duong_tri_dao.y_ung_dung: A clear Head Line reflects structured thinking; in decision-heavy years, write criteria down clearly instead of multitasking.

duong_su_nghiep.ten: Line of Career — Long-Term Commitment Axis
duong_su_nghiep.nguyen_van_en: I now turn my attention to a vertical line, one of the five lines the starting points of which are to be found in the lower part of the palm and the terminations more or less close
duong_su_nghiep.y_ung_dung: When the vertical central line is clearer on the active hand than the passive hand, deliberate daily practice is shaping a stronger direction than baseline habit.

duong_thai_duong.ten: Line of the Sun — Follow-Through & Craft
duong_thai_duong.nguyen_van_en: Artistic instincts but insufficient powers of execution; the “Art amateur’s Line.
duong_thai_duong.y_ung_dung: Saint-Germain notes that creative instinct requires steady execution: finishing concrete deliverables builds lasting credibility.

tam_giac_tu_giac.nguyen_van_en: There are two figures in the hands traced by the combination of the principal Lines which I had often occasion to mention but not to define or expatiate upon all through these page
tam_giac_tu_giac.y_ung_dung: Balanced spacing between Heart and Head lines points to even-handedness when collaborating under pressure.

nhip_hanh_nam.Kim: A Metal-toned year favors streamlining commitments, clear boundaries, and steady breathing routines.
nhip_hanh_nam.Mộc: A Wood-toned year supports learning fresh skills, constructive outreach, and regular outdoor movement.
nhip_hanh_nam.Thủy: A Water-toned year favors deep research, careful listening, and protecting restorative sleep.
nhip_hanh_nam.Hỏa: A Fire-toned year brings brisk activity; pace milestones calmly and keep an evening wind-down routine.
nhip_hanh_nam.Thổ: An Earth-toned year favors consolidating savings, reliable workflows, and grounded family routines.

hai_tay.thuan_troi: Active hand clearer than passive hand: your conscious routines and present choices are actively steering your path beyond baseline temperament.
hai_tay.khong_thuan_troi: Passive hand clearer than active hand: strong natural reserves are present, though recent energy may be scattered across too many fronts.
hai_tay.can_doi: Both hands show comparable clarity: outer commitments and inner temperament are moving in steady alignment.
